one_liner: Ranks every number by its rate in the last 26 draws minus its rate in the 182 draws before it.
registry_status_reason: Revision 1 installed for review and not yet released (E2R-R58): IN_DEVELOPMENT.txt is present and no SUPPORTED entry exists.
short_explanation: E_10 looks at each number on its own. It compares each number's rate in the last 26 draws (about half a year) with its rate in the 182 draws before it, so its highest-ranked numbers are those rising fastest and its lowest-ranked those falling fastest. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 208 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
